limitations: Thirty original finest finite-load fields have freshly assembled stiffness/mass/RHS, exact original continuous nodal-load reproduction and complete original force/corner/quadrature/probe checks. Twelve new assets use the byte-identical original CAD generator. Both latest physical changes at two additional levels are still pending full solves/audits. These CAD/volume axes are coupled, source/material/physical radius and load law stay unchanged, and all original raw maxima and probes remain. No new physical tail or native accuracy/cost acceptance follows from qualifications or geometry assets. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
